research_caveat: WebFetch was blocked at the network proxy for every pin-database and retailer host (pinpics.com, pinandpop.com, pintradingdb.com, shopdisney.com, boxlunch.com, hottopic.com, disneypinsblog.com, ebay.com, mercari.com, reddit.com, waltdisney.org all returned 403 CONNECT denials). All evidence below comes from WebSearch result listings (titles, URLs and search-engine page summaries) for those same URLs. No secondary-market sold-comp data could be retrieved, so market_low/median/high are null on every record and price_confidence is 'low' throughout. Retail prices are recorded only where a retailer listing stated one. The Walt Disney Family Museum pin and the sushi-with-a-hat pin could not be researched before the search budget was exhausted and are deliberately absent rather than guessed.

pins.name: Character Alphabet Mystery Collection
pins.notes: Best current candidate for the collector's four tall letter-shaped pins. Each pin in this Disney Parks mystery collection is a large single capital letter with a character and small background scene set into/behind the letter, and the collection includes glitter 'chaser' variants of some letters. Confirmed members seen: E for Elsa (glitter chaser, PinPics 107652) and D for Duffy. Working hypothesis for the collector's set: the four pins are not four letter D's but four different letters from one alphabet series -- D for Dumbo, E for Elsa, N for Nala, plus a fourth whose scene includes goblets/glasses (Lumiere, Gaston or Chip from Beauty and the Beast would all fit). That reading resolves the Frozen/Dumbo/Lion King combination exactly. Total set size, release year, park of origin and retail price could not be confirmed.

pins.name: Character Alphabet Mystery Collection — E for Elsa (Glitter Chaser)
pins.notes: PinPics page describes Queen Elsa with the letter E rendered in glittery blue and a snowflake in the background. The base letters in this collection are non-glitter, which makes the glitter version the chase variant. This is the closest documented match to the collector's Frozen/Elsa letter pin.

pins.name: Character Alphabet Mystery Collection — D for Duffy
pins.notes: eBay listing 'Character Alphabet Mystery Collection - D - Duffy ONLY Disney Pin'. Duffy appears in his sailor suit and hat with his face inside the bowl of the letter D and his ears breaking outside the letter outline — confirming the series' construction of a large letter as the pin silhouette with the character set into it. Documented from the search-result listing only.

pins.name: Disney Pixar Alphabet Mystery Pin Collection
pins.series: Disney Pixar Alphabet Mystery Pin Collection
pins.notes: Pixar-only sibling of the Character Alphabet mystery series, covered by Disney Pins Blog. Same letter-as-silhouette construction. Confirmed member: F for Flik. Set size and release year not confirmed.

pins.name: Disney Pixar Alphabet Mystery Pin — F for Flik
pins.series: Disney Pixar Alphabet Mystery Pin Collection
pins.notes: Listed by dealer yourwdwstore as 'Disney Mystery Pin - Pixar Alphabet - F - Flik'. The trailing number in the dealer URL is that shop's own item number, not a Disney SKU or PinPics ID, so both fields are left null.

pins.name: Alphabet Letter Collection — D is for Dory (Finding Nemo)
pins.notes: eBay title reads 'Disney Trading Pin - Alphabet Letter Collection D is for Dory - Finding Nemo'. Series attribution is ambiguous: it could belong to the Pixar Alphabet mystery collection or to the Hidden Mickey alphabet set (which other sources say uses Duchess for D). Left with series null rather than guessing.

pins.name: DLR Hidden Mickey Series — Alphabet Letter Collection (26-pin set)
pins.notes: 26 pins, one per letter of the alphabet, each pairing a letter with a Disney character whose name starts with it. CONTRADICTION: PinPics and multiple dealer listings label these 'Hidden Mickey 2011', while the Disney Wiki article on the Hidden Mickey Alphabet Set gives a release date of November 20, 2008 (fifth series, Wave A, Disneyland). These may be two waves of the same concept or the wiki date may be wrong; year recorded as 2011 with this discrepancy flagged. Note that Frozen postdates both dates, so this set cannot be the source of the collector's Elsa letter pin.

pins.name: DLR Hidden Mickey — A for Alice
pins.notes: PinPics page PP82323, titled 'DLR - A for Alice - Alphabet - Hidden Mickey 2011'.

pins.name: DLR Hidden Mickey — N for Nala
pins.notes: Described in listings as showing a young Nala from The Lion King sitting to the side of the letter N. This is the documented 'Nala letter pin' — but as a 2011 pin it belongs to a set that predates Frozen, so the collector's Nala pin may instead be the N from the later Character Alphabet Mystery Collection. A dealer URL for this pin contains the number 82336, which in that shop's convention is usually a PinPics number; not recorded as pinpics_id because it was not verified on PinPics itself.

pins.name: DLR Hidden Mickey — S for Simba
pins.notes: Catalogued on Pin Trading DB as 'DLR - 2011 Hidden Mickey Series - Alphabet Letter Collection - S for Simba'. The /pin/1497 in that URL is Pin Trading DB's internal record number, not a PinPics ID.

pins.name: Hidden Mickey Alphabet — D for Duchess
pins.notes: Disney Wiki's Hidden Mickey Alphabet Set list assigns D to Duchess (The Aristocats), not Dumbo — relevant because the collector's 'Dumbo-like' letter pin therefore probably comes from a different alphabet series. Year left null due to the 2008-vs-2011 discrepancy noted on the set record.

pins.name: Character Alphabet Hinged Pin Series
pins.notes: Released November 2024 at Shanghai Disney Resort as open edition pins: letter-shaped pins with a hinged element that opens. A second candidate for the collector's letter pins, though this is a park-exclusive Shanghai release. Full letter/character roster and price not retrievable.

pins.name: SHDR — Disney Character Alphabet Design Pin — Letter D
pins.notes: Sold by Hong Kong proxy retailer BelloShopHK as 'SHDR - Disney Character Alphabet Design Pin - Letter D'. Almost certainly the letter D from the Shanghai Character Alphabet series above; the character shown inside the D was not visible in the search listing. Directly relevant to the collector's letter-D pins.

pins.name: Monogram Pin Series
pins.notes: Pin & Pop catalogues a 4-pin Disney 'Monogram' series comprising Frozen 2 Olaf, Cinderella (Ball Gown), Stitch and one further pin not named in the listing. Notable because it is a four-pin letter/monogram series and the collector owns exactly four letter pins including a Frozen one — but the rest of the roster (Cinderella, Stitch) does not match the collector's Dumbo/Nala/goblets pins, so this is a weaker candidate than the Character Alphabet Mystery Collection.

pins.name: Monogram — Frozen 2 Olaf
pins.notes: Named as a member of the Pin & Pop 'Monogram' series. Series position is inferred ordering only, not an official numbering.

pins.name: Monogram — Cinderella (Ball Gown)
pins.notes: Named as a member of the Pin & Pop 'Monogram' series. Series position is inferred ordering only.

pins.name: Monogram — Stitch
pins.notes: Named as a member of the Pin & Pop 'Monogram' series. Series position is inferred ordering only.

pins.name: Disney Complete 26 Alphabet Letter A–Z Circle Pin Set
pins.notes: Marketplace-assembled 'complete A–Z' alphabet trading-pin set listed by Walmart third-party sellers, eBay and Mercari, and by dealer yourwdwstore as 'Disney Alphabet Pin - A through Z'. These are ROUND pins, not letter-silhouette pins, so they do not match the collector's tall letter-shaped pins. Included to rule out. Whether these are genuine park pins or reproductions is not established by the listings — treat with caution.

pins.name: Disney Princess Letter Mystery Pin Set
pins.notes: Dealer listing 'Disney Mystery Pin Set - Disney Princess Letter - 2 Random'. A princess-themed letter mystery series sold two pins at a time. Roster and release year not documented in the listing.

pins.name: Magical Theater Pin Series
pins.notes: Monthly 2026 pin series, LE 4500, sold at multiple locations (WDW, DLR). Each pin is a tall ARCH-shaped pin: a decorative theater proscenium with red curtains framing a film scene. Included as the leading ALTERNATIVE identification for the collector's four 'tall letter D shaped' pins — a tall pin with a rounded/arched top and flat bottom is easily described as a letter D, and this series is exactly 'a scene inside a tall arched frame'. Against it: no Frozen, Dumbo or Nala release confirmed in the months documented, and the series is 2026-new rather than a completed set.

pins.name: Magical Theater — Beauty and the Beast
pins.notes: First pin of the series: Belle and Beast dancing in the ballroom, framed by a decorative proscenium theater arch. Catalogued on Pin & Pop as PIN 113340 (Pin & Pop's own record number, not a PinPics ID). A Beauty and the Beast pin is the most likely home for the collector's 'goblets/glasses' scene, though the ballroom scene documented here does not itself feature goblets.

pins.name: Magical Theater — Peter Pan
pins.notes: Third release in the monthly Magical Theater series: Peter and Wendy inside a proscenium theater arch. Edition size assumed to match the series' stated LE 4500; not separately confirmed for this pin.

pins.name: Magical Theater — The Lion King
pins.notes: Fifth monthly Magical Theater pin: Simba, Pumbaa and Timon inside a brown, gold and green theater proscenium with red curtains. Released at both DLR and WDW in May 2026. Note this is Simba/Timon/Pumbaa, not Nala — so it is not the collector's Lion King pin. Edition size assumed to match the series' stated LE 4500.

pins.name: Disney Bookmark Tassel Blind Box Enamel Pin — BoxLunch Exclusive

price_sources.name: BoxLunch product listing
price_sources.note: Retail price $12.90 stated in the listing; no secondary-market comps retrievable

pins.notes: THIS IS THE COLLECTOR'S TASSEL SERIES. BoxLunch-exclusive blind-box series of six mystery pins, each a tall bookmark-shaped pin featuring a different Disney film with a real fabric tassel attached at the bottom — matching the collector's three tall rectangular pins with hanging tassels. $12.90 each, no choice / no returns, and a special GLITTER CHASE pin shipped at random with no guarantee. Confirmed members: Alice in Wonderland, Bambi, Dumbo, and The Jungle Book (the glitter chaser); two further pins in the six were not named in any retrievable listing. BoxLunch style number 35008762. The collector's pale-blue-and-white floral Alice-ish pins are consistent with the Alice in Wonderland design and/or the shared decorative bookmark border used across the series.

pins.name: Disney Bookmark Tassel Blind Box — Alice in Wonderland
pins.notes: Named as one of the six pins in the Bookmark Tassel blind-box series by Pin & Pop's series roster. Strongest single match for the collector's pale-blue-and-white floral tasselled pins, since Alice's colour palette is exactly pale blue and white. Exact artwork not verifiable without page access.

pins.name: Disney Bookmark Tassel Blind Box — Bambi
pins.notes: Named as one of the six pins in the Bookmark Tassel blind-box series by Pin & Pop's series roster.

pins.name: Disney Bookmark Tassel Blind Box — Dumbo

price_sources.name: eBay active listings

pins.notes: Confirmed by an eBay listing titled 'Disney Bookmark Tassel Blind Box Enamel Pin Dumbo -BoxLunch Exclusive -Opened'. Relevant to Family A as well: the collector's 'Dumbo-like' pin could conceivably be this tasselled bookmark rather than a letter pin.

Chasers in blind-box series typically carry a substantial secondary-market premium over the $12.90 retail, but no comps were retrievable so no figures are recorded.

pins.notes: Predecessor/sibling of the tasselled bookmark series: a blind-box PAIR consisting of a book pin plus a matching bookmark pin. BoxLunch style number 31607596. Whether the bookmark half carries a fabric tassel was not verifiable. Useful context for the collector's tassel family.

pins.name: Disney Princesses Book & Bookmark Blind Box Enamel Pin — BoxLunch Exclusive
pins.notes: Princess-themed entry in BoxLunch's book-and-bookmark blind-box line. BoxLunch style number 20530582. Earliest of the three book/bookmark releases judging by the lower style number.

pins.name: Disney Pixar Book Blind Box Enamel Pin Set — BoxLunch Exclusive
pins.notes: Pixar entry in the same BoxLunch book-pin family. BoxLunch style number 31714691. Included for completeness of the bookmark/book blind-box lineage; no tassel confirmed.

pins.name: Pin Trading Around the World Dangle — Disney Cruise Line (Surprise Release)
pins.notes: PinPics PP16640, 'Pin Trading Around the World Dangle - Disney Cruise Line (Surprise Release)'. A classic hanging/dangle-construction pin — included as notable non-tassel dangle context. Edition type recorded as Limited Release on the basis of the 'Surprise Release' designation; edition size unknown.

pins.name: Tangled — Pascal and Rapunzel Lamp Dangle Pin
pins.notes: Catalogued on Pin & Pop as PIN 46069 (Pin & Pop record number, not a PinPics ID). Notable dangle pin: a lamp/lantern element hangs from the main pin body. Included as dangle-family context.

pins.name: Disney Alice In Wonderland Garden Flowers Blind Box Enamel Pin
pins.notes: Hot Topic blind-box assortment of pins depicting the different flowers from Wonderland's gardens. Hot Topic style number 33930509. Included because it is the other Alice-plus-florals blind-box line a collector could easily conflate with the tasselled bookmark pins — no tassel on these.

pins.name: Loungefly Disney Movie Blind Box Enamel Pin
pins.notes: Loungefly's general Disney-movie blind-box pin line at Hot Topic, style number 11572421. Context record for the Loungefly/Hot Topic blind-box ecosystem the collector's tassel pins sit in.

pins.name: Loungefly Disney Icons Blind Box Enamel Pin
pins.notes: Loungefly Disney Icons blind-box pin line at Hot Topic, style number 12375310. Context record.

pins.name: Character Boba Tea Collection

price_sources.name: Disney Pins Blog release post
price_sources.note: Retail $12.99 each stated at release; no sold comps retrievable

pins.notes: THIS IS THE COLLECTOR'S BOBA PIN SERIES. Open-edition Disney Parks pins, $12.99 each, released April 2024 at both Disneyland and Walt Disney World, sold at both resorts. Each pin is a boba/bubble-tea sipper cup themed to a character, with tapioca pearls and a wide boba straw. Pin & Pop catalogues the series as six pins; confirmed members are Dumbo, Marie (The Aristocats) and Winnie the Pooh, with three further pins not named in retrievable listings. eBay listings label them 'W1', implying a wave-1 designation and likely follow-on waves.

Boba Fett's green-and-red helmet forms the lid of a cup filled with boba pearls, with a wide boba straw through the helmet — the 'character as food/drink' crossover pun taken to its logical end. Edition type and price not stated in the coverage.

pins.name: WDW — Disney Park Foods Pin Set of 6
pins.notes: A boxed six-pin Walt Disney World set themed to park foods, carried by proxy retailer USShoppingSOS. The individual foods depicted were not visible in the search listing. This is the core 'Disney Parks snack pin' set the collector's food pins would sit alongside.

pins.name: Disney Characters in Fruit Blind Box Enamel Pin — BoxLunch Exclusive
pins.notes: BoxLunch-exclusive blind-box series placing Disney characters inside fruit — a direct example of the 'Disney character as food' crossover category. BoxLunch style number 17125807. The collector's 'sushi with a hat' pin is most likely from a comparable character-as-food blind-box line, but it could not be identified before the research budget ran out.
